lines.text: The LORD speaks against the family He brought out of Egypt and says He has known only Israel.
The questions ask whether a bird lands in a snare without bait, and whether people tremble when a ram's horn sounds.
The Lord GOD reveals His plan to the kings of Israel, and when the lion roars, who will not fear?
Ashdod and Egypt are told to assemble on the mountains of Samaria, where an enemy will surround the land and plunder citadels.
The LORD says He will punish Israel and destroy the altars of Gilgal, and the horns of the altar will be cut off.
